Name: Anna Lollipop - Custom NPC UPDATE 2.1.0
Author: AnnasCreator
Description:
[center][u][font=Arial][b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/VkG36qLZ/anna-multi-portraits-v2.png[/img]
[/b][/font][/u]
[b][size=5][font=Arial]There's a new girl in town.[/font][/size][/b]
Anna showed up in Pelican Town out of the blue, with zero plan and complete confidence that it would work out. She came from the Gallia Continents, a place far far away with its own language, culture, and a level of corruption that eventually led to her arrival in town. She got on the first plane she could, traveled a while, and eventually ended up here.

She's staying with Haley for now until her own place is fully built.

You'll find her around town being dramatic, complaining loudly about the summer heat, and standing outside in the snow in the middle of winter having a fun time. She's warm, chaotic, loyal to the people she lets into her circle, and privately carrying a lot on her shoulders.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/B61cDNQ2/Anna-Features.png[/img]

[u][font=Arial][b]﻿This mod is currently under development.[/b][/font][/u][font=Arial] Anna's current features are:[/font]

[list]
[*][b]Full seasonal dialogue[/b] — unique lines for every day of the week across all four seasons, plus weather-specific and heart-level-gated dialogue that shows her character deepening over time.[/*]
[*][b]5 heart events[/b] — a complete story arc from first meeting to a moment of true honesty, including a branching 8-heart event with a good and bad ending.[/*]
[*][b]Marriage content[/b] — morning lines, evening lines, rainy day dialogue, seasonal married lines, post-kiss reactions, and more.[/*]
[*][b]Custom portrait sheet[/b] — 9 expressions including her signature lollipop portrait.[/*]
[*][b]French dialogue sprinkled throughout[/b] — Anna slips into Gallican (French) when she's emotional, frustrated, or just not thinking about it.[/*]
[*][b]Alternate appearance's add-on[/b] — Two optional Alternate appearance mod available separately ([i]Gallia Ball Dance and You Seem Pretty in Love[/i]) toggleable via GMCM. (WILL NO LONGER BE SUPPORTED PAST 2.1.0)[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Requirements:[/size][/b]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][color=#e06666]SMAPI[/color][/url][/center]
[center]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][color=#e06666]Content Patcher[/color][/url]

[b][size=3]Alternate Appearances Req:[/size][/b]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][color=#e06666]GMCM[/color][/url]

[b][size=6]UPDATE[/size][/b]
[b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/RVGYs7fZ/Anna-Features-2-1-0.png[/img]

[/b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/7hxKPrL7/Anna-File-House.png[/img]
Anna has a house! Beginning year 1, Anna will live with Haley, as she has been. Near the community center, there will be a construction site. That's where her house will be constructed. Once the player hits year 2, Anna's house will have been fully built. A move-in event will play if the player has 6+ hearts with anna by the time year 2 hits

[b]2.1.0:[/b]
- Anna now has her own spouse room[/center]
[center]- Added a marriage schedule
- Added a spouse patio (undecorated)
- New kiss and sleep sprites
- Fixed marriage dialogue not playing correctly
- Fixed a pathfinding error when Anna was married
- Fixed inconsistent collision when talking to Anna outside
- Cleaned up several harmless SMAPI log errors
- NOTE: MAY BREAK ANNA FROM SAVES WITH PREVIOUS VERSION[/center]
